title: Balance numbers 70 (pipe_amber_pct) and 6 (lane_queue_packets) restated in code, not derived from catalog
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:499  `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || p.util_pct >= 70 {`
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:634  `cur = noc_section(v, cur, scroll, visible, "QUEUES VS E9 BOUND (6)")`
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:643  `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < 70 {`
while the neighboring bars do derive from canon (lines 635-637): `bound := u32(max(1, cat.balance.lane_queue_packets))` / `amber_pct := cat.balance.warnings.pipe_amber_pct` / `red_pct := cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct`
detail: Project rule ODN-5: "Numbers single-source: balance numbers live in data/*.json, never restated in code"; the readability ruling demands dev tools "derive from them ... never invent ladders". The queue-row filter and the section label hardcode 70/6, so a balance.json tune silently makes the filter and label contradict the canon-derived bars.
recommended_fix: Pass cat into noc_queue_rows/noc_panel_rows and gate rows on pipe_amber_pct; build the section label with fmt.tprintf("QUEUES VS E9 BOUND (%d)", cat.balance.lane_queue_packets).

title: overlay-check hash sidecar is not byte-identical to goldens for paused demos or partial-run captures
evidence:
harness/overlay.odin:80 `wall_max := min(u64(max(0, i64(cap_ms) * i64(hz) / 1000)), total_wall)`
harness/overlay.odin:85-89:
```
	for w in u64(1)..=wall_max {
		before := len(state.events)
		if paused_at(cfg.pauses[:], w, hz) {
			free_all(context.temp_allocator)
			continue // a paused wall tick steps nothing
		}
```
harness/run.odin:401-405 (the golden writer) DOES append for paused walls:
```
		if paused {
			...
			append(&hashes, pp.state_hash(&state, state.events[before:], cat, context.temp_allocator))
```
detail: Frozen AC: "Given overlay-check <demo> <ms> ... the emitted hash stream is byte-identical to goldens/<demo>.t1". The sidecar omits paused-wall-tick hashes and truncates at cap_ms, so any paused demo or sub-full capture diverges (e.g. the committed 10000ms capture yields 200 hashes vs the golden's 240).
recommended_fix: Append the paused-stability hash in overlay_check's paused branch (mirroring run.odin) and emit a header noting truncation, or document that the proof requires pause-free demos captured at full run length.

title: Stale 'F-key' comment at the draw site contradicts the final D-key ruling
detail: The frozen spec ruling is final: "the D KEY stays as the toggle ... F is dropped (fallback only if the D binding itself were broken)". The comment names the wrong key; behavior is correct (D toggles), but the text misleads maintainers hunting an F binding.
recommended_fix: Change the comment to 'the D-key debug surface' (one-word edit; no code change).

title: noc_feed_fold_drop double-counts drop_other when an event has both an unknown reason byte and an out-of-domain class
detail: Frozen AC: "drop counters summing exactly the Packet_Dropped events". One event with reason ∉ {Queue_Overflow, Pool_Exhaustion} AND class ≥ 64 increments drop_other twice, so drop_e9+drop_pool+drop_other exceeds the event count. Unreachable with valid sim payloads (Drop_Reason has exactly 2 members; classes are catalog-bounded).
recommended_fix: Count the class-bucket overflow into a separate field (e.g. drop_bad_class) or guard the reason-bucket increment so each event lands in exactly one bucket.
